svg.title: Finalized cluster map — all niches across 4 clusters
svg.desc: Four horizontal rows showing cluster 1 Appointment and Booking in blue, cluster 2 Trade and Professional in teal, cluster 3 Commerce and Logistics in amber, cluster 4 Technology and Accounts in purple. Each row shows build priority, immediate 12 niches, and future expansion niches.
svg.text: Finalized cluster map — all niches → 4 clusters
